hero.eyebrow: Mobile Detailing · Peak District & North Derbyshire
hero.sub: Liquid All Sorts brings hand-finished car, motorhome & caravan detailing, plus driveway pressure washing, straight to you across Belper, the Peak District and North Derbyshire.

services.name: Car Detailing
services.desc: Interior and exterior valeting finished to a mirror shine — from a quick refresh to full paint correction and long-lasting protection.

services.name: Motorhome & Caravan Detailing
services.desc: Roof to wheel arches. We handle the height, the road grime and the algae a home wash can't reach, so it's ready for the road again.

services.name: Pressure Washing
services.desc: Driveways, patios, decking and paths blasted back to their original colour — without damaging the surface underneath.

services.name: Ceramic Coating & Paint Protection
services.desc: A durable, hydrophobic layer over the paintwork that locks in the shine and makes every wash after it easier — ideal before a long drive or a sale.

services.name: Fleet & Commercial Valeting
services.desc: Regular valeting for vans, work cars and company fleets, kept sharp and presentable on a schedule that fits around your working week.

services.name: Gutter & Roof Cleaning
services.desc: Gutters and roof lines cleared of moss, leaves and grime, so water keeps flowing freely and damp doesn't get a foothold.

testimonials.name: Michael R.
testimonials.text: Booked a full valet before selling the car and it looked better than the day I bought it. Turned up on time and worked with real care over every panel.

testimonials.name: Diane & Paul H.
testimonials.text: Our motorhome hadn't been properly cleaned in two seasons. They got right into the roof vents and awning rail — genuinely impressed with the attention to detail.

testimonials.name: Josh T.
testimonials.text: Driveway was black with algae and moss. Now it looks brand new again. Quick, tidy, and no mess left behind afterwards.

testimonials.name: Amrita K.
testimonials.text: Professional from the first message to the final wipe-down. Easy to book and the finish speaks for itself — already got them booked in again.
